<h1 className={"openapi__heading"}>Delete a tracing account</h1>

<MethodEndpoint method={"delete"} path={"/v1/account-management/consumption/tracing-accounts/{id}"}></MethodEndpoint>



Deletes a tracing account of a **Consumption** owner account.
Available for **Consumption** accounts only. If the account is not a Consumption account, the request returns `400`.

Please ensure to change the region in the URL to match your account's region.
